outcome: Qualify GAR 10.0.0 from a preserved successor, resolve release metadata and skill maintenance gaps, synchronize through a reviewed GitHub change, and publish only if every mandatory release gate has fresh passing evidence.
acceptance_criteria: The exact published v8.1 baseline and active dev.4 candidate hashes, source-tree fingerprints, archive manifests, and lineage are recorded before implementation; old releases and evidence remain unchanged.

A new versioned successor is created from the verified dev.4 consumer archive; dev.1 through dev.4 remain immutable, and the release directory and archive agree on version, provenance, release date, documentation, and skills.

All 19 GAR skills are inventoried for freshness, applicability, source and maintenance ownership; selectively updated content has exact origin, license, revision, digest and safe attribution, and game-specific user-local skills are not mistaken for packaged GAR skills.

Known GAR10 findings are corrected or explicitly shown not to block the scoped release by fresh evidence and independent review; no failure, skip, low scanner finding, host limitation, or unknown is silently marked passed.

Fresh relevant regression and negative checks pass; external scanners and dependencies have bounded, reproducible provenance; the final archive is deterministic, manifest-complete, path-safe, secret-free, and passes validation from a clean extraction.

All applicable architecture, security, UX, quality, AI, data, FinOps, and release gates have current evidence and no unresolved blocker; independent review and required human comprehension evidence are recorded.
The reviewed source is synchronized to a GitHub branch and pull request; v10.0.0 is merged, tagged, and released with the exact qualified archive and hashes only after the release bar is met.

A reviewed GitHub branch/pull request and v10.0.0 merge, tag and release if gates pass.
